column1: # The irregular-forms half of the lemma table for `close_paraphrase`
# (`content_word_retention`, L4's tight fence). Two tab-separated columns:
# WHY A COMMITTED FILE AND NOT AN NLP LIBRARY: a silently updated lemmatizer
# changes L4 verdicts underneath the judge cache, so the table is data, it is
# versioned by `scoring_version`, and changing it is a reviewed diff.
# It is SMALL on purpose. The metric is a ratio over a ~200-word passage, so a
# handful of misses moves it by half a percent, while a 40 MB lemmatizer would
# The regular cases (plural, past, gerund, -ly/-ness) are handled by the suffix
# rules in `lemma()` — `scoring.toml [lemma] stemmer` names which rule set.
# Lines starting with `#` and blank lines are ignored. `form` is matched after
